$comment: NORMATIVE. The correctness invariant every theloopskill-mcp tool rests on, plus the arithmetic rules that make estimate_phase reproducible. Companion to docs/design/ADR-0005-correctness-invariant-no-silent-default.md. Composes with mcp/runtime-pin.json (D1), mcp/tool-contracts.json (D3) and mcp/extraction-contract.json (D4); amends none of them.
appliesTo: every tool and every resource read of theloopskill-mcp

measurementBaseline.note: with D4's execution-modes.md repair applied (5 insertions / 5 deletions, uncommitted at measurement time)
measurementBaseline.probe: scratchpad/d5probe/vmprobe.mjs plus inline node -e runs; not committed

D5_1_invariant.oneSentence: Every answer is derived from a located source span, or is an error naming the span it could not find.

I1_provenance.statement: Every field of every ok:true result is either (a) the content of a byte range of a named source file located by coordinate, or (b) the value of a pure total function applied to such ranges and to caller arguments already validated against an enumeration itself read from a source range.
I1_provenance.prohibition: No field is ever a value the server selected because a lookup failed.

I2_totality.statement: Every call terminates in exactly one of two outcomes.
I2_totality.outcomeA: ok:true, citations[] non-empty, every citation resolving (D3.2 round-trip).
I2_totality.outcomeB: ok:false, naming the span it could not find — the file, and the heading or RFC 6901 JSON Pointer it looked under.
I2_totality.prohibition: There is no third outcome: no partial result, no result carrying a substituted default, and no unnamed throw.

layerArgument.scriptLayer: execution-modes.md §M8:306-392 — forgives, correctly, because H10 (harness-policy.md:76) leaves a script no way to refuse without dying mid-DAG.
layerArgument.parserLayer: execution-modes.md §M2:59 — 'An unrecognized value is never guessed: name the three valid values and ask.'
layerArgument.ruling: An MCP tool is a parser-layer citizen. It does not inherit §M8's fallbacks.
layerArgument.repoAcknowledgement: execution-modes.md §M9.5:421 already names the hazard: 'ROUTES[MODE] falls back to balanced for any unrecognized value rather than failing loudly', and records the breaking rename it forced in loop-autopilot/templates/improvement-loop.workflow.js.

D5_2_proof.label: PROVED
D5_2_proof.shape: structural induction over the answer-construction function
D5_2_proof.precondition: Every caller-supplied value used as a KEY into a source-derived table is checked for membership in that table's key set — read from the source — BEFORE any evaluation or lookup occurs.
D5_2_proof.preconditionOwner: the server, in code. ADR-0001's hand-rolled zero-dependency runtime supplies no JSON-Schema enforcement, so the enum D3.6 advertises is documentation until the server enforces it.
D5_2_proof.baseCase: a located span; provenance is the locator (file, heading regex, fence ordinal, line range) plus D3.2's sha256 over the LF-normalized range.
inductiveStep: (i) projection or field read of a located value — provenance inherited
(ii) lookup T[k] where T derives from a located span and k was validated by the precondition — total on its domain, so the fallback arm is unreachable and provenance is inherited from T
(iii) arithmetic over located numerals — covered by D5_4
D5_2_proof.completeness: There is no fourth step shape: the only construct that can introduce an unsourced value is a fallback arm, and (ii) makes every such arm unreachable.
D5_2_proof.termination: validation is a finite membership test over a finite enumeration; evaluation is bounded by D4.3's vm timeout of 1000 ms; every path reaches ok:true or an ok:false in D4.5's closed code set.
D5_2_proof.counterexamplesTheProofRejects: the 11 measured adversarial inputs in D5_3_measuredSilentDefaults and D5_3_measuredKindFallback
D5_2_proof.notClaimed: EVIDENCE-level generation was not run; the input domains are a 5-element and a 10-element enum, so D5_5 requires exhaustive enumeration instead.

D5_3_measuredSilentDefaults.$comment: MEASURED 2026-07-27 by vm.runInContext over the REAL §M8 block located by D4.2's coordinate walk (lines 306-392, 6278 bytes), input constructed inside the vm per D4.3.

rows.note: the exact scenario §M2:59 names as the failure
§M2:59 opens with 'Both flags are case-insensitive'; §M8:311 uses indexOf, which is case-SENSITIVE. A layer split, not a typo.

rows.error: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'analyze')
rows.cause: MODE_ALIAS is a plain object literal, so its prototype chain is in the key domain; MODE_ALIAS['constructor'] is truthy, MODE becomes a function, ROUTES[MODE] is undefined, and §M8:351's `|| ROUTES[MODE].analyze` dereferences it.

TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'analyze')
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'analyze')

D5_3_measuredSilentDefaults.notADefectInM8: D5 does NOT rule on §M8 and proposes no edit to it. No flag parser can emit 'constructor', the block is duplicated verbatim into 27 templates where any edit is a fleet-wide change, and the fallbacks are correct for a script under H10. These rows are a statement about who must validate, not about who is wrong.

D5_3_measuredKindFallback.$comment: MEASURED, same probe. §M8:351 `routeFor = (kind) => (ROUTES[MODE] && ROUTES[MODE][kind]) || ROUTES[MODE].analyze`. UNRULED before D5: D3.5's closed error enum has no unknown_task_kind, and D4.5's unknownModeInteraction covers only :311.

rows.delta: model pin LOST (inherits session), effort max->high, width 3->1

D5_3_measuredKindFallback.severity: The sharper of the two branches. §M3:87 describes the gating row as 'a false all-clear ships the defect'. A one-character typo silently loses the model pin and two thirds of the verifier width, and returns a plausible, fully-formed, CITABLE route while doing it.

D5_3_1_validateBeforeEvaluate.rule: Validate `mode` against the accepted five and `taskType` against the ten keys of ROUTES[MODE] BEFORE evaluating §M8.
D5_3_1_validateBeforeEvaluate.enumSource: READ FROM THE LOCATED BLOCK, never hardcoded. A hardcoded enum is itself a silent default about what the source says.
D5_3_1_validateBeforeEvaluate.absentIsLegal: An ABSENT optional argument takes the default the SOURCE declares (mode -> balanced, §M2:59). An absent argument is not a failed lookup, so I1 is untouched. A PRESENT-but-unrecognized value has no declared default and is an error. This distinction is the whole rule.
D5_3_1_validateBeforeEvaluate.rejection: D3.5's in-band error envelope, and the message MUST name the valid values (§M2:59).

D5_3_2_unknownTaskKind.rule: Symmetric to unknown_mode. The message MUST enumerate the ten kinds and MUST NOT guess.
D5_3_2_unknownTaskKind.effect: §M8:351's `|| ROUTES[MODE].analyze` arm becomes unreachable from the server while staying intact in the block for the 27 templates that need it.

D5_3_3_probesThrowNamed.rule: A doc-shape probe failure (D4.7 E1-E8) is a STRUCTURAL error under D4.5. It names the file and the heading or fence it could not find. It is never converted into 'the previous answer' or 'the default block'.
D5_3_3_probesThrowNamed.seamWithD2: The server does not die; the CALL does. initialize, tools/list and resources/list still succeed (ADR-0002 degrade-not-die). A missing document is answered in band, with the fix instruction, on the call that needed it.

D5_3_4_crosscheckIsAnError.rule: A cross-check mismatch propagates as ok:false carrying BOTH readings with BOTH citations. Never resolved by precedence at call time.
D5_3_4_crosscheckIsAnError.why: Both readings are located spans; I1 cannot pick between them without inventing a preference. Returning either as ok:true is a silent default about which file is right.
D5_3_4_crosscheckIsAnError.scope: The D4.1 authority ladder settles which FILE to fix; it does not license answering while the other file misinforms every human who reads it.

D5_3_5_noPartialTable.rule: The unit of parse-success is one Markdown table under one heading. Either every row parsed (parsed:true), or NONE of it is (parsed:false, raw text, plus a row in unparsedSections naming the reason).
D5_3_5_noPartialTable.prohibition: Never some rows of one table.
D5_3_5_noPartialTable.why: Half a table is the worst possible answer: a caller cannot distinguish 'this shelf has four standards' from 'this shelf has nine and five rows failed a regex'.
D5_3_5_noPartialTable.livePath: MEASURED by D3: of 21 shelves, 2 yield zero table rows and 6 lack the three-grade vocabulary.
D5_3_5_noPartialTable.reconciliation: This is how D3's 'degrade rather than promise rows' and D5's 'no silent default' are the same rule, not a compromise between them.

D5_3_6_noClockNoRandomness.rule: Forbidden anywhere in estimate_phase's reachable code.
D5_3_6_noClockNoRandomness.sourceForFirstFour: §M6:177 — 'pure deterministic arithmetic over the authored DAG. No sampling, no Date.now(), no Math.random(), no argless new Date().' D5 extends the list and binds it to the server.
D5_3_6_noClockNoRandomness.whyItIsLoadBearing: §M6:437 — 'the same DAG under the same mode yields byte-identical numbers on every run — which is exactly what makes an approved estimate diffable against actual spend.' §M6:237-241 stamps the approved figures into the script as `const ESTIMATE = {...}` so the gate can diff approved-vs-actual against journal.jsonl. One clock read destroys that permanently.

D5_3_7_noCaching.ruling: v1 re-locates and re-reads on every call. No cache, no watch mode. A DECISION, not an omission.

measuredCost.readBothSubstrates: 0.729 ms per call (145.76 ms over 200 iterations, warm page cache) for execution-modes.md 48550 bytes + boundary-audit.json 70859 bytes read and JSON.parsed
measuredCost.total: under 3 ms against a model turn

D5_3_7_noCaching.argument: Freshness becomes a property of the mechanism rather than an invariant somebody maintains: no cache key to get wrong, no invalidation to miss, no window in which the server answers from a document the user has already edited. That last one matters more here than in a normal service, because the expected editing session IS someone changing these documents and asking the server what they now say.
D5_3_7_noCaching.revisitCondition: a measurement showing the read is material
D5_3_7_noCaching.revisitKey: (path, size, mtimeNs, sha256) — never path alone, and never mtime alone: mtime has one-second granularity on some filesystems, which is a silent default about whether a file changed.

D5_4_arithmetic.$comment: Makes §M6:437's byte-identity a PROVED property of the estimator rather than an accident of today's calibration table.
D5_4_arithmetic.formula: §M6:196 — tokens(n) = agents(n) × BAND[kind][mode] × SIZE[n.size], summed componentwise (low, high)

hazard.statement: §M6:225 defines SIZE compact as ×0.4. 0.4 is NOT representable in IEEE-754 binary64.
hazard.whyItDoesNotBiteToday: MEASURED: all 19 distinct BAND endpoints in §M6:211-217 are divisible by 5, so band × 0.4 lands exactly on the integer 2·band/5 for every published value. 0 non-integer results over the full table; float and integer paths agree.
hazard.whyThatIsNotSafe: The exactness rests on a property of the constants that nothing in the repo requires, documents, or checks — while §M6:223 mandates 'Re-baseline both columns at every gate', §M6:219 records every row was already lifted ~2.5× on 2026-07-27, and §M6:437 calls BAND and SIZE 'the only tunable numbers in this file'.

A1_exactRationals.rule: SIZE is an exact rational pair, never a decimal literal. The multiplier never appears as 0.4 in server code.
A1_exactRationals.prose: §M6:225's '×0.4' stays as it is — it is the right thing to say to a human. D5 does not edit it.
A1_exactRationals.pinnedEquivalence: num/den === 0.4 at every published band — MEASURED true for all 19 endpoints. A re-baseline that breaks it fails the D5_5 canary rather than silently drifting.

A2_roundAtNodeSumInIntegers.rule: subtotal = floor((2·agents·band·num + den) / (2·den)), all operands integers — round-half-up on the exact rational agents·band·num/den. Then sum the integer subtotals.
A2_roundAtNodeSumInIntegers.why: Rounding happens at exactly ONE declared point with exactly ONE declared rule. A rounding rule that is declared and applied at a fixed point is not a silent default; an implicit float truncation appearing wherever the last operation happened to land is.

A3_orderIndependence.label: PROVED
A3_orderIndependence.statement: Under A2 every subtotal is a non-negative integer and every partial sum is a non-negative integer ≤ 2^53, hence exactly representable in binary64; binary64 addition of exactly-representable values whose exact sum is exactly representable is exact; exact integer addition is associative and commutative; therefore the total is independent of node iteration order.

measuredMargin.worstRealisticNode: 25 agents × 230000 (the 'planner on Fable' all-out high band, §M6:217) × 3 (long-form)
measuredMargin.note: §M6:254's ≤15-agents-per-workflow guideline keeps real DAGs well under this.

measuredCorroboration.experiment: 5 nodes with bands not divisible by 5, all 5! = 120 summation permutations
measuredCorroboration.reading: Three answers to one question is a DISPROOF of §M6:437's byte-identity for the float path under a re-baselined table.

A4_guards.safeInteger: Assert Number.isSafeInteger on every subtotal and on the running total. A violation is `internal`, never a rounded answer.
A4_guards.exactFlag: The estimator reports exact:true|false per node so a caller can tell a rounded subtotal from an exact one. That flag is derived, not defaulted.

D5_4_arithmetic.notRuledHere: §M6's BAND and SIZE VALUES, which are calibration (§M6:437). D5 rules how they are combined, never what they are.

D5_5_gateAssertions.assert: Every row of D5_3_measuredSilentDefaults with class SILENT-SUBSTITUTION or UNNAMED-THROW is REJECTED by the server with code unknown_mode, and the message text contains all three of 'lite', 'balanced', 'all-out'.
The accepted-five (lite|balanced|all-out|optimize|full) all succeed; optimize and full canonicalize on output and appear only in deprecations[] (D3.3).
An ABSENT mode succeeds and resolves to balanced with no deprecation and no note — the declared default of §M2:59 is not an error.
Exhaustive over taskType: all ten kinds succeed; the four typo forms (gate, Gating, gatiing, 'gating ') are REJECTED with code unknown_task_kind and a message naming all ten kinds.
No route_node response in the whole gate run ever equals ROUTES[MODE].analyze when the requested taskType was not literally 'analyze'. The fallback arm is unreachable.
estimate_phase over one DAG in all 120 permutations of a 5-node ordering returns exactly 1 distinct (agents, tokensLow, tokensHigh) triple, and every component is Number.isSafeInteger.
Static scan of estimate_phase's reachable code finds zero occurrences of the eight forbidden non-determinism sources in D5_3_6.forbidden.

standards_shelf per-section atomicity: for every returned section, either entries.length equals the source table's row count with parsed:true, or entries is empty with parsed:false and a matching row in unparsedSections. Never a partial row set.

CANARY — every BAND endpoint parsed from §M6:211-217 satisfies band % 5 === 0. On failure the gate reports that a re-baseline reintroduced the float hazard and that A1/A2's integer path is the only thing still holding byte-identity. Advisory-loud: fails the gate, and the fix is to confirm the integer path, not to revert the calibration.

requiredAdditionsToD3Enum.$comment: D5 does NOT edit mcp/tool-contracts.json — it is another agent's phase artifact and its error enum is declared closed. Recorded here so the implementer applies it, and raised as an open question.
requiredAdditionsToD3Enum.codeDoc: A taskType outside the ten keys of ROUTES[MODE]. Message MUST name the ten valid kinds and MUST NOT guess (§M2:59, by symmetry with unknown_mode). Never resolve via §M8:351's analyze fallback.

D5_6_notRuledHere: The content of §M8 (execution-modes.md:306-392). D5 proposes no edit; the block is correct for a script under H10 and is duplicated verbatim into 27 templates.
§M6's BAND and SIZE VALUES — calibration, per §M6:437.

§M2:59's case-insensitivity promise versus §M8:311's case-sensitive indexOf. D5 records the split and rules that the server folds nothing and accepts nothing unfolded; it does not rule on whether §M8 should fold.
Whether the golden-query gate lives in CI — packaging, deferred by the approved v1 line and already flagged by D2 and D4.
The consumer routers' own validation. D5 binds the server only.
